facility.name: Kids First Learning Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Product Certification has not been certified since 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2025 data from January 20, 2026, determined the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2025 by January 15, 2026, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was a caregiver at the center that had a deactivated background check.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food: In the kitchen counter top there were cleaning supplies were food is prepped.     NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver stored the cleaning supplies away from the area where food is prepped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food (26 TAC §746.3317(10))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name: In the infant room there a labeled diaper rash cream in another childs bin.    NOTE: This was corrected during the inspection when caregiver removed the diaper rash cream from the bin and disposed of it in the garbage bin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name (26 TAC §746.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Fire inspection has expired, it has not been conducted since 3/27/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two of the four employee records are missing annual trainings: Hazardous materials, allergic reactions, medical administrations, building safety, communicable diseases, emergency preparedness, 1 hour abuse/neglect,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: One of the 4 employee records reviewed is missing the application form that includes date of employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: In the outdoor playground area there was a broken toy accessible to the children.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the toy from the playground area and disposed of it in the large garbage bin outside of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Fire inspection is expired, the date the fire inspection was last conducted was on October 25, 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: Employees list was posted but had not been updated to have the new employees on the list.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the list was updated and posted on the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The outdoor area was inspected and was not kept in a sanitary manner.  Leaves were all over the play area on top of toys making the toys to be unsanitary for the children to use.  There were spider webs in the play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Student records were reviewed during inspection the following documents were missing:    2 out of 4 student records were missing a statement of the child s health from a health-care professional.    1 out of 4 student records was missing Immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Activity plan and daily menu was not posted with required postings for parents to see.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Child was observed on incorrect mat that was not labeled with the child's name.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver moved the child to the mat labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: While reviewing staff records the following was missing:  4 out of the 4 staff records were missing the employment date.  NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver wrote down the date of employment.  1 out of the 4 staff records had an expired driver's license.   NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when director made a copy of the new driver's license and put it in the staff's file.  2 out of 4 staff files needed to fill out the orientation section on form 2947.  NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when director filled out the section.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,   2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who   left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Checks Kept Confidential: Back ground check was missing from 4 out of 4 staff files.    NOTE: Director printed out the background checks for 4 out of the 4 missing employee background forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Checks Kept Confidential (26 TAC §746.201(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: Operation did not have the most recent licensing form posted.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when director printed the form 2936 and posted it on the parent notification wall at the entrance of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Garbage bins in two restrooms did not have a lid on them making garbage accessible to children.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the garbage bins from the restrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
